session_summary: As the Combat Challenger, I completed Frostfang Pass (Difficulty 3) with a clean run, facing only two low-friction encounters (Slime and Kobold) across 12 steps. Despite the high difficulty rating, the encounter pacing felt sparse, offering very little mechanical challenge or tactical engagement.

observations.evidence: In Frostfang Pass (Difficulty 3), only 2 combat encounters occurred across 12 steps (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with long stretches of uninterrupted walking and jumping.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn density and introduce mini-boss or elite variant encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to align with the Combat Challenger persona goals.

observations.evidence: Encountered standard basic enemies (Slime and Kobold) on Frostfang Pass, which features 'ice spikes' hazards but lacks distinct enemy mechanics tied to the freezing theme.
observations.recommendation: Integrate theme-specific status effects or attack patterns for enemies found in high-difficulty environmental hazards.

feature_requests.title: Elite Combat Waves & Aggressive Enemy AI Profiles
feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-tier players with genuine mechanical mastery tests, satisfying demands for intense risk/reward encounters.
feature_requests.rationale: Current high-difficulty routes rely primarily on environmental hazards rather than engaging, high-density combat pressure.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce tougher elite enemy compositions and dynamic combat waves specifically for difficulty 3 routes like Frostfang Pass and Whispering Fen.

keep: Clean telemetry logging for enemy defeats and route progression.
Clear separation of route themes, hazards, and collectibles.
focus: encounter pacing, enemy friction, risk/reward, challenge and mastery
